CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an explicit organized pattern (many coordinates listed), and a separate origin/status field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to a content's organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color and coordinate sets) are asserted.

D.rationale: The text separates content identification (red coordinates) from provenance/status metadata (origin/record_status) for the same referent.

O.rationale: The report explicitly presents organized/patterned representations (full coordinate sets) for identified contents.
